title: The Names of God
definition: The names of God are the ways God reveals His character, nature, works, covenant faithfulness, authority, and relationship to His people.
summary: In Scripture, God's names are not empty labels. They reveal who He is. He is Creator, Lord, Almighty, Shepherd, Redeemer, Father, and the covenant-keeping God who makes Himself known to His people.
christFocus: Jesus reveals the name and character of the Father. In Christ, believers come to know God not merely as Creator and Lord, but as Father through redemption and adoption.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: God's names reveal His character. When Scripture calls Him LORD, Almighty, Shepherd, King, Father, or Redeemer, it teaches believers how to know Him, trust Him, and worship Him.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Knowing God's names helps believers pray with confidence, worship with understanding, and trust His character in every season of life.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: When you read the names of God in Scripture, slow down and ask what God is revealing about Himself. Let His names shape your prayer, worship, trust, and obedience.
